pr_title: Fix some crashes, overflows and using variables without  values
pr_body:
Fixes #32723
Fixes #31140 - I checked and seems that src[i]. always(or almost) return value (-1;1) and uint_t was a typo


Added function uitos to String, to prevent overflow Core and Editor API

Added to VisualShaderNodeCubeMap, RayShape and VisualScript value to some variables to prevent spam every time I open editor(I usually open it with sanitizer support which show error when using variables without values)

In Image::shrink_x2 and FileAccessUnix::store_buffer checks  should prevent using null pointers

issue_context.title: Error -127 is outside the range of representable values of type 'unsigned char' in visual_server.cpp
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.dev.custom_build 7126654ea

**OS/device including version:**
Ubuntu 18.04

**Issue description:**
logs
```
servers/visual_server.cpp:514:17: runtime error: -127 is outside the range of representable values of type 'unsigned char'
SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior servers/visual_server.cpp:514:17 in 
servers/visual_server.cpp:515:17: runtime error: -12.4482 is outside the range of representable values of type 'unsigned char'
SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior servers/visual_server.cpp:515:17 in 
servers/visual_server.cpp:513:17: runtime error: -2.42852 is outside the range of representable values of type 'unsigned char'
SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior servers/visual_server.cpp:513:17 in 
```
This code
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4188b0c139dc71b425528db97afdc1e54c2fb5b4/servers/visual_server.cpp#L512-L517
should probably look like a little above(uint_8 -> int_8)
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4188b0c139dc71b425528db97afdc1e54c2fb5b4/servers/visual_server.cpp#L477-L482
or clamp should have this values CLAMP(value,0,255)
comments:
I think it should be signed int. Line 512 was most likely a typo and then the following casts in lines 513-516 were added afterwards https://github.com/sparkart/godot/commit/e2b50e1abbc6cab58410a2ef4155bdcadf73efcf#diff-23cec7725ea48162a903e4160145a2ceR482

That's my guess.

review_comments: There should be a comment to explain why the setter code is being duplicated here.
